charts.title: HD 224018 d: orbits around HD 224018
charts.description: The orbits of HD 224018's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 224018 d highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Damasso et al. 2025 (2025A&A...702A.118D), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname DAMASSO_ET_AL_2025): P 138.0731 d
